registration.rotation: One training-selected spin; nonnegative speeds <=600 km/s at 40,80,140,220,320,450,600 arcsec; zero at center.
registration.geometry: Global PA +/-20 and inclination +/-10 degrees; outer warp bounds unchanged at 15/8 degrees. Six damped implicit radius iterations.
registration.starts: Three rotation starts at 0.7/1/1.3 seed speed and -7/0/+7 PA; full starts from nested rotation, best simpler training fit and fixed mixed seed.
registration.selection: Minimum penalized training objective among converged starts; held-out score evaluated only afterwards.
registration.caution: Conditional same-observation source brightness; projected model, native beam velocity mixing and complete spectral response remain unvalidated.
registration.synthetic_generator: Independent NumPy analytic tanh rotation + varying dispersion at twice resolution; one case includes multiple vertical layers, lag and Hanning spectral smoothing.
